book_name: 新一代大学英语综合教程2基础篇

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.tr: adj. 令人紧张不安的；令人胆怯的；
words.ex: The big dog looked intimidating to the small child.
words.ex_cn: 那只大狗看起来让小孩子感到紧张不安。
words.en: Something that is intimidating makes you feel nervous and frightened because it is very difficult, dangerous, or extreme.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: The loud thunder terrified the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的雷声吓坏了那个孩子。
words.en: If something terrifies you, it makes you feel extremely frightened.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the vent.
words.ex_cn: 烟从排气口飘了出来。
words.en: A vent is a hole or opening that allows air, gas, or liquid to pass out of or into a confined space.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；捅
n. 戳；刺；捅
words.ex: He poked the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke means to prod or jab someone or something with a finger or a pointed object, or to move something in a particular direction with a sharp movement. It can also refer to the act of making a hole or opening in something by pushing a pointed object into it.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.ex: He shook the bottle vigorously.
words.ex_cn: 他有力地摇晃了瓶子。
words.en: If you do something vigorously, you do it with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. 除其他事情外；尤其
words.ex: She talked about her travels, among other things.
words.ex_cn: 她谈到了她的旅行，以及其他一些事情。
words.en: used to say that there are other details, examples, etc., that could be mentioned but you are mentioning only some of them

words.tr: phrase. 靠在…上；依赖；施压；威胁
words.ex: He leaned on the wall to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在墙上休息。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support or assistance, or to apply pressure in order to influence someone.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 打断某人说话；切断对某人的供给或联系
words.ex: The phone line was cut off during the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 电话在通话过程中被切断了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking; to stop someone from communicating with others.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 切断某物；中断供应；阻止进入
words.ex: The power company cut the electricity off during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 电力公司在暴风雨期间切断了电力供应。
words.en: To remove something from something larger by cutting.

words.tr: phrase. v. 切断……与……的联系；使……与……隔绝
words.ex: The storm cut the island off from the mainland.
words.ex_cn: 风暴切断了岛屿与大陆的联系。
words.en: To separate or isolate someone or something from others or from a source of support.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 被卷入某事中；陷入某事；过于投入某事而无法脱身
words.ex: She often gets caught up in her work and forgets to eat.
words.ex_cn: 她经常忙于工作而忘记吃饭。
words.en: To become involved in something, often without intending to.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然遇见；意外碰到
words.ex: I bump into my friend at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店碰到了我的朋友。
words.en: If you bump into someone you know, you meet them unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人敞开心扉；向某人倾诉；对某人坦诚
words.ex: She decided to open up to her therapist about her past traumas.
words.ex_cn: 她决定向她的治疗师敞开心扉，倾诉过去的创伤。
words.en: To share one's thoughts or feelings with someone, especially after keeping them secret.

words.tr: phrase. 通过惨痛教训学会；吃一堑长一智
words.ex: He learned the hard way that smoking is bad for health.
words.ex_cn: 他通过痛苦的经历才明白吸烟有害健康。
words.en: To gain knowledge or experience through difficult or unpleasant experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 通过惨痛经历学会某事；吃一堑长一智
words.ex: He had to learn the hard way that honesty is the best policy.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不通过艰难的方式学到诚实是最好的策略。
words.en: To learn something through difficult or unpleasant experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持某事；紧紧抓住某物
words.ex: In times of trouble, we must hold fast to our beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 在困难时期，我们必须坚定信念。
words.en: To continue to believe in or adhere to an idea, principle, etc., despite difficulties or opposition.

words.ex: The savings amount to $500.
words.ex_cn: 这些储蓄加起来是500美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total. If an idea, feeling, or action amounts to something, it has the same effect or importance as that thing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 意味着；相当于；总计达到
words.ex: His debts amount to over $50,000.
words.ex_cn: 他的债务总计超过5万美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: The manager will empower the team to make decisions.
words.ex_cn: 经理将授权团队做决定。
words.en: To give someone the authority or power to do something.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.ex: The child had an undiagnosed illness.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子患有一种未确诊的疾病。
words.en: If a medical condition is undiagnosed, it has not been identified by a doctor.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: He worked hard, and ultimately succeeded.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终成功了。
words.en: You use ultimately to indicate that something is the final result of a series of events or the most important part of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 春假（尤指美国学校在春季的假期）
words.ex: Many students travel during spring break to enjoy the warm weather.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在春假期间旅行，享受温暖的天气。
words.en: A vacation period in early spring at universities and schools in some countries.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
words.en: Uncertainty is a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.ex: He forgot his homework, and understandably, the teacher was upset.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了作业，老师生气是可以理解的。
words.en: In a way that is easy to understand or that seems reasonable or expected.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.tr: v. 重新评价；再估价；使升值
words.ex: He will reevaluate his decision tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重新评估他的决定。
words.en: If you reevaluate something or someone, you consider them again in order to reassess your opinion about them, especially if you think that your opinion should be changed.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.ex: She showed empathy when her friend cried.
words.ex_cn: 当她的朋友哭泣时，她表现出了同感。
words.en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.ex: I feel sympathy for the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 我对那些可怜的孩子感到同情。
words.en: If you have sympathy for someone who is in a bad situation, you are sorry for them, and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: She is empathetic toward her friend's sadness.
words.ex_cn: 她对朋友的悲伤富有同理心。
words.en: Someone who is empathetic has the ability to share another person's feelings or emotions as if they were their own.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: The doctor checked his gut for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The gut refers to the stomach and other internal organs of an animal or person, often used to describe the digestive tract. It can also metaphorically represent courage or determination.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: The movie was incredibly funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极其搞笑。
words.en: In a manner that is difficult to believe; extremely.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.ex: In the wake of the storm, the city was left in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，城市变成了一片废墟。
words.en: Following immediately after, often as a result of.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐地；一点一点地；慢慢地
words.ex: He learned to swim little by little.
words.ex_cn: 他一点一点地学会了游泳。
words.en: Gradually; in small stages or increments.

words.ex: I will stick with this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我会坚持这个计划。
words.en: To continue to support or use something, even though it may be difficult or you may want to change to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 处于某人的境地；设身处地；站在某人的角度考虑
words.ex: I wouldn't want to be in his shoes when the boss finds out.
words.ex_cn: 当老板发现时，我可不想处于他的位置。
words.en: In someone else's position or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 在内心深处；本质上；实际上
words.ex: Deep down, he knows he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 在内心深处，他知道他犯了错误。
words.en: If you know something deep down, you know it although you may not admit it to yourself.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: 短语动词. 已经掌握或拥有某项经验、技能或成就
words.ex: If you have a certificate under your belt, you can get a better job.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有了证书，就能找到更好的工作。
words.en: If you have something under your belt, you have already achieved or experienced it, which can give you confidence or advantage in future endeavors.

words.tr: v. 激怒；使急躁；使疼痛
words.ex: Loud noises irritate my baby.
words.ex_cn: 噪音会激怒我的宝宝。
words.en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；愉悦的；
words.ex: The trip was a pleasurable experience.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行是一次令人愉快的经历。
words.en: Something that is pleasurable is enjoyable or gives you pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.ex: He looked at me with confusion.
words.ex_cn: 他困惑地看着我。
words.en: A state of uncertainty about what is happening, intended, or required.

words.tr:
adj. 未说出的；未表达的
v. 取消；撤回；’“unspeak”的过去分词
words.ex: There was an unspoken agreement between them.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间有一个未说出口的协议。
words.en: If something is unspoken, it has not been said, although it might have been thought or felt.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.tr: phrase. 指导顾问；学校辅导员（负责为学生提供学业、职业和个人发展方面的建议与支持）
words.ex: The guidance counselor helped me choose the right college.
words.ex_cn: 咨询老师帮我选择了合适的大学。
words.en: A guidance counselor is a professional who works in schools or colleges to help students with their academic and personal issues, career planning, and college admissions.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.ex: Too many rules can complicate the game.
words.ex_cn: 太多的规则会使游戏变得复杂。
words.en: To make something more difficult to understand or deal with by adding more parts or details.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。
words.en: An acquaintance is someone you know a little, who is not a close friend.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.ex: The milk will go sour if you leave it out of the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外面，它会变酸。
words.en: If food or drink goes sour, it becomes sour or unpleasant to taste because it is no longer fresh.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.tr: phrase. 此时此地；现在立刻
words.ex: Let's focus on the here and now instead of worrying about the future.
words.ex_cn: 让我们专注于此时此地，而不是担心未来。
words.en: At this moment; immediately.

words.ex: He read the book out loud.
words.ex_cn: 他大声读了这本书。
words.en: If you say something out loud, you say it so that other people can hear you.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.ex: He is largely responsible for the project's success.
words.ex_cn: 他主要对这个项目的成功负责。
words.en: To a great extent; mostly.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.tr: v. 故态复萌；退步；再犯
words.ex: He backslid into old habits after quitting smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他戒烟后又回到了旧习惯。
words.en: To revert to bad habits or undesirable activities after a period of improvement.

words.ex: She consciously chose to walk instead of driving.
words.ex_cn: 她有意识地选择走路而不是开车。
words.en: If you do something consciously, you do it deliberately, being fully aware of your actions and their possible effects.

words.tr: v. 居住于；生活于；移民于
words.ex: Many people populate this small town.
words.ex_cn: 许多人居住在这个小镇上。
words.en: To populate an area means to live in it or to fill it with people or things.

words.ex: Exercise can elevate your mood.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提升你的情绪。
words.en: To elevate something means to raise it to a higher position or level, either physically or in terms of its status or importance.

words.ex: He wants to rid his house of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱家里的杂乱。
words.en: To rid someone or something of something unwanted or harmful means to remove it completely from them.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: He gave her an abusive shout.
words.ex_cn: 他对她大喊大叫，态度虐待。
words.en: If someone is abusive, they use rude and insulting words or behave violently towards someone else.

words.ex: His acceptance of the offer made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了这份提议，让大家都很高兴。
words.en: The act of agreeing to receive or undertake something offered.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: The teacher gave her approval for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这个项目表示了赞成。
words.en: If you give your approval to something, you agree with it or allow it to happen.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: He told me privately that he was leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他私下告诉我他要离开。
words.en: If something is done privately, it is done without other people being present or knowing about it.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He lives alone by choice.
words.ex_cn: 他独自生活是出于自己的选择。
words.en: If you do something by choice, you do it because you want to do it and not because you are forced to do it.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 忠于；支持；信守（诺言、决定等）
words.ex: He promised to stick by her no matter what happened.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺无论发生什么都会忠于她。
words.en: To remain loyal to someone or something, especially in difficult times.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧握住；坚持下去；保留
words.ex: He hangs on to his old wallet because it reminds him of his dad.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧保留着旧钱包，因为它让他想起爸爸。
words.en: To keep something that you have, especially because it might be useful or valuable in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 放手；松开；释放；放弃
words.ex: He decided to let go of the old toy.
words.ex_cn: 他决定放开那个旧玩具。
words.en: To release one's hold on something or someone; to allow someone or something to leave or be free.

words.ex: He is late at times.
words.ex_cn: 他有时会迟到。
words.en: on some occasions; occasionally

words.tr: phrase. 坚持到底；贯彻执行；完成（计划或行动）
words.ex: He didn't follow through on his promise.
words.ex_cn: 他没有兑现自己的承诺。
words.en: To continue an action or task to its conclusion.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 逐渐侵蚀；慢慢消耗；使内心感到不安或痛苦
words.ex: Worry can eat away at your happiness.
words.ex_cn: 担忧会慢慢侵蚀你的幸福感。
words.en: To gradually destroy or erode something, often in a subtle or unnoticed way.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.ex: He reluctantly agreed to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不情愿地同意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you do something reluctantly, you do it unwillingly.

words.ex: She took a glance at the clock.
words.ex_cn: 她瞥了一眼钟。
words.en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

words.tr: adv. 高高兴兴地；愉快地
words.ex: She sang cheerfully while walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 她一边走路去学校，一边愉快地唱歌。
words.en: In a way that shows happiness or optimism.

words.tr: adv. 绝望地；拼命地；不顾一切地；极度地
words.ex: He is desperately trying to find his lost dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拼命寻找他丢失的狗。
words.en: In a way that shows a lack of hope and a willingness to do anything to change a situation, often involving a lot of effort or risk.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: His rude words detract from the beauty of the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话贬损了演讲的优美。
words.en: If one thing detracts from another, it makes it seem less good or impressive.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: His speech was coherent and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲连贯且易于理解。
words.en: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.ex: He is zealous about helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他热心帮助别人。
words.en: If someone is zealous, they are enthusiastic and eager about something, especially something they believe in very strongly.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.tr: adj. 延长的；扩大范围的；延伸的；
words.ex: The meeting was extended by thirty minutes.
words.ex_cn: 会议被延长了三十分钟。
words.en: Made larger or longer than usual.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: He gave a dumb answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个简单的问题给出了一个愚笨的回答。
words.en: If someone is dumb, they are unable to speak. If you describe someone or something as dumb, you mean that they are stupid or silly.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.tr:
v. 大口吞咽；喘气；抑制
n. 一大口；吞咽
words.ex: He gulped down his water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速地吞下了水。
words.en: If you gulp something, you eat or drink it very quickly by swallowing large quantities of it at once.

words.ex: Practice can sharpen your skills.
words.ex_cn: 练习可以提高你的技能。
words.en: To make or become sharp or sharper.

words.ex: It's ironic that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: If you say that it is ironic that something happens, you mean that it is odd or amusing because it involves a contrast or is the opposite of what you would expect.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: The youngster rode his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻人每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A youngster is a young person, especially a child or teenager.

words.tr: phrase. 秘密地；暗地里；私下地
words.ex: They were meeting in secret to discuss their plans.
words.ex_cn: 他们秘密会面讨论他们的计划。
words.en: Done, made, or conducted without the knowledge of others.

words.tr: phrase. 最；独一无二最（用于强调某事物在程度或重要性上超越所有其他同类事物）
words.ex: She was the single most important person in his life.
words.ex_cn: 她是他生命中最重要的人。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is more important or significant than anything else.

words.tr: phrase. 唯一最大的；最重大的（强调在所有同类事物中规模最大或程度最高）
words.ex: The single biggest challenge facing the company is the lack of skilled workers.
words.ex_cn: 公司面临的最大挑战是缺乏熟练工人。
words.en: The most significant or important of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 唯一最伟大的；独一无二的最杰出者
words.ex: She is the single greatest athlete of her generation.
words.ex_cn: 她是她这一代最伟大的运动员。
words.en: The most outstanding or exceptional of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 最糟糕的（唯一一个最差的）
words.ex: This is the single worst decision I have ever made.
words.ex_cn: 这是我做过的最糟糕的决定。
words.en: The most unpleasant or severe of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 临场应变；随机应变；在压力下快速思考并作出反应
words.ex: In a debate, it's crucial to think on your feet and respond to your opponent's arguments effectively.
words.ex_cn: 在辩论中，迅速思考并有效回应对手的论点至关重要。
words.en: To think and react quickly, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑某事；把某事想透彻
words.ex: Before making a decision, it's important to think the problem through.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定之前，彻底考虑问题是很重要的。
words.en: To consider something carefully and thoroughly, especially before making a decision.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.tr: phrase. 稀释；冲淡；弱化（尤指观点、声明或要求）
words.ex: They water down the juice to make it last longer.
words.ex_cn: 他们把果汁加水稀释，让它撑得久一点。
words.en: To dilute or weaken the strength, force, or effectiveness of something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人宽容一些；对某人不要太严厉
words.ex: Please be easy on her; she's going through a tough time.
words.ex_cn: 请对她宽容些；她正经历一段艰难的时期。
words.en: To treat someone with leniency or kindness, often in a situation where they might expect criticism or punishment.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人宽容一些；对某人手下留情；不要对某人太严厉
words.ex: Please go easy on her; she's still learning.
words.ex_cn: 请对她宽容点，她还在学习中。
words.en: To treat someone gently or leniently.

words.ex: The numbers add up to 100.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字加起来等于100。
words.en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.ex: He unpacks his bags after arriving home.
words.ex_cn: 他到家后打开行李。
words.en: To unpack means to open and remove the contents of a container, such as a suitcase or a box, or to explain or analyze something in detail.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

words.ex: He interjected during the meeting to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中插话问了一个问题。
words.en: To say something that interrupts someone who is speaking.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.tr: adv. 连续地；不断地；连续不断地；
words.ex: The machine works continuously without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器连续工作，不停止。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: The politician gave a short soundbite on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这位政客在电视上发表了一段简短的言论。
words.en: A short and striking or memorable phrase or sentence, often used in media.

words.ex: He remarked that the weather was nice.
words.ex_cn: 他评论说天气很好。
words.en: If you remark that something is the case, you say that it is the case.

words.tr:
n. 暂停；停顿；
v. 暂停；停顿；
words.ex: There was a short pause before he answered.
words.ex_cn: 他回答之前停顿了一下。
words.en: To pause means to stop what you are doing for a short time before continuing.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: She was a gifted conversationalist, always able to keep the conversation flowing.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有天赋的健谈者，总能保持谈话的流畅。
words.en: A conversationalist is someone who is good at or enjoys conversation.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.ex: She strongly believes in honesty.
words.ex_cn: 她强烈相信诚实。
words.en: In a strong manner; with strength or force.

words.ex: The story shows the humanness of the hero.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事展现了英雄的人性。
words.en: The quality or condition of being human; human nature.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: He dug out an old photo from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他从盒子里翻出了一张旧照片。
words.en: To remove something from the ground by digging; to find something after searching.

words.tr: phrase. v. 快速翻阅；浏览
words.ex: He flips through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速地翻阅这本书。
words.en: To quickly turn the pages of a book, magazine, etc., especially without reading everything.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；捍卫；为…挺身而出
words.ex: He will stand up for his friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对他的朋友刻薄时，他会为朋友挺身而出。
words.en: To support or defend someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 跳入；迅速投入；突然开始；仓促参与
words.ex: He jumped into the pool to save the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他跳入泳池去救那只狗。
words.en: To leap or dive into a place or to start something suddenly and enthusiastically.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: It took time for the news to sink in.
words.ex_cn: 这则消息花了点时间才让他明白。
words.en: If a fact or idea sinks in, you gradually start to believe it, understand it, or realize the effect it will have on you.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: He blurted out the secret by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心说出了秘密。
words.en: If someone blurts something, they say it suddenly, after trying hard to keep quiet or to keep it secret.

words.ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故的记忆仍然长期困扰着他。
words.en: If something unpleasant haunts you, you keep thinking or worrying about it over a long period of time. A place that is haunted is believed to be visited regularly by a ghost.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: He gave an intentional wrong answer to confuse the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他故意答错答案来迷惑老师。
words.en: Something that is intentional is done on purpose, not by chance.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.tr:
adj. 危地马拉的
n. 危地马拉人
words.ex: The Guatemalan culture is rich in traditions and history.
words.ex_cn: 危地马拉文化在传统和历史方面非常丰富。
words.en: Of or relating to Guatemala or its people, culture, or language.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.tr: n. 满；完全；十分；丰满；发胀
words.ex: The fullness of the orchestra's sound was breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 管弦乐队的声音之丰富令人叹为观止。
words.en: The state of being full or complete.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.tr:
adj. 有教养的；文雅的；人工培养或养殖的
v. 培养；“culture”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is a cultured man who loves art and music.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有教养的人，喜欢艺术和音乐。
words.en: If you describe someone as cultured, you mean that they have good manners, are well educated, and know a lot about the arts.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.ex: She showed compassion for the homeless man.
words.ex_cn: 她对那个无家可归的人表示同情。
words.en: Compassion is a feeling of pity, sympathy, and understanding for someone who is suffering.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.ex: He worked hard and reaped the rewards.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，获得了回报。
words.en: To reap means to cut and gather a crop, or to obtain something, especially as a result of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 开始（谈话、友谊、音乐等）；主动建立（关系或联系）
words.ex: They struck up a lively tune as soon as they entered the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们一进房间就开始演奏欢快的曲子。
words.en: If you strike up a conversation or friendship with someone, you begin one.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人开始（交谈、友谊、关系等）
words.ex: They struck up a conversation at the party and soon became good friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们在派对上开始交谈，很快就成为了好朋友。
words.en: If you strike up a conversation or friendship with someone, you start one.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: 习语. 至少可以说；说得最轻一点（用于缓和语气，暗示实际情况比所说的更严重）
words.ex: The movie was boring, to say the least.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影至少可以说是无聊的。
words.en: used to indicate that something is the minimum that could be said, often implying that the reality is much more extreme.

words.tr: phrase. 闲聊；闲扯；漫无目的地聊天
words.ex: We sat on the porch and shot the breeze all evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们坐在门廊上整个晚上闲聊。
words.en: To engage in casual conversation without any serious purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 在耳中回响；余音绕梁；耳鸣
words.ex: After the concert, I had a ring in my ears for hours.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会结束后，我的耳朵里嗡嗡响了好几个小时。
words.en: If a sound rings in your ears, you continue to hear it, usually because it was very loud or impressive.

words.ex: He drove so fast that he lost sight of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他开得太快，看不见路了。
words.en: If you lose sight of something, you forget about it or stop thinking about it because you are focusing on other things.

words.tr: 短语动词. 充分反映某人的优点或真实情况；公正地评价某人
words.ex: To do him justice, he's always been honest in his dealings.
words.ex_cn: 公平地说，他在交易中一直都很诚实。
words.en: To treat someone fairly or to represent someone or something in a way that fully shows their good qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 公正地对待；充分展现……的价值或优点
words.ex: This movie does justice to the book.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影忠实地还原了这本书。
words.en: To treat someone or something in a fair or appropriate way; to be adequate or sufficient for something.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: The store is temporarily closed.
words.ex_cn: 这家店暂时关闭了。
words.en: For a limited time; not permanently.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.tr:
v. 细述；叙述
n. 叙述；重新计票
words.ex: He tried to recount the accident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他试图向警察重新叙述那场事故。
words.en: To recount means to tell someone about something that happened, often in detail; or to count something again to make sure the number is correct.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.tr: v. 彻底变革；使革命化；
words.ex: The new technology will revolutionize how we learn.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将彻底变革我们的学习方式。
words.en: To completely change something, especially in a way that improves it.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The painter portrays a happy family in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家在画中描绘了一个幸福的家庭。
words.en: To portray someone or something means to show or represent them in a painting, film, book, or other artistic work.

words.tr:
adj. 下意识的；潜意识的；
n. 潜意识；下意识；
words.ex: He made a subconscious decision to help her.
words.ex_cn: 他下意识地决定帮助她。
words.en: The subconscious is the part of your mind that contains feelings and thoughts that you are not directly aware of but that can influence your behavior and emotions.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.tr: adj. 荒唐的；荒唐可笑的；
words.ex: It's absurd to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套是荒唐的。
words.en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

words.tr: adj. 评价过高的； v. “overrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: That movie is overrated; it's not that good.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影评价过高；其实没那么好。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is overrated, you mean that people have a higher opinion of them than they deserve.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.ex: He felt the stigma of being unemployed.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了失业的耻辱。
words.en: A stigma is a strong feeling of disapproval that most people in a society have about something, especially when this is unfair.

words.tr: adj. 有特权的； v. “privilege”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a privileged student who gets free books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有特权的学生，能免费获得书籍。
words.en: Having special rights, advantages, or immunities.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: He stared at the moon all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚凝视着月亮。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.tr: v. 幻想；想象；做白日梦
words.ex: He fantasizes about winning the lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他幻想自己中彩票。
words.en: To fantasize means to imagine something that is very pleasant or exciting, but is very unlikely to happen.

words.ex: The new software vastly improves speed.
words.ex_cn: 新软件极大地提高了速度。
words.en: To a very great extent or degree.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.tr: adj. 难以相信的；难以置信的；
words.ex: The magic trick was unbelievable.
words.ex_cn: 那个魔术难以相信。
words.en: If you say that something is unbelievable, you are emphasizing that it is very good, impressive, intense, or extreme.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr:
v. 盖印；印刻；使铭记
n. 盖印；痕迹
words.ex: He used a stamp to imprint his name on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他用印章在盒子上盖印了他的名字。
words.en: To imprint something means to mark or stamp it with a design or a symbol. It can also mean to fix something firmly in someone's mind.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人大吃一惊；使某人震惊或印象深刻；彻底震撼某人的思维
words.ex: The new movie really blew my mind.
words.ex_cn: 这部新电影真的让我大为惊讶。
words.en: To amaze or astonish someone greatly.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: He went to elementary school in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他曾在纽约上小学。
words.en: An elementary school is a school for children in their first few years of education, especially those between the ages of 5 and 11.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr: adv. 气喘吁吁地；屏息地
words.ex: She ran breathlessly up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 她气喘吁吁地跑上楼梯。
words.en: In a way that shows you are breathing very quickly or with difficulty, especially because you are excited or have been running.

words.ex: He painstakingly checked every answer before submitting the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在提交试卷前极其仔细地检查了每一个答案。
words.en: With great care and thoroughness.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr:
adj. 舞台上的；台上演出的
adv. 在舞台上
words.ex: The actor looked nervous onstage.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在舞台上显得很紧张。
words.en: When someone is onstage, they are performing or speaking in front of an audience in a theatre or concert hall.

words.ex: The narrator told the story in a calm voice.
words.ex_cn: 叙述者用平静的声音讲述了这个故事。
words.en: A narrator is a person who tells a story, or a person who speaks during a film or television program not as an actor but to describe or discuss the pictures being shown.

words.tr: n. 不安；担心；焦虑；不满
words.ex: She felt a growing unease as the day went on.
words.ex_cn: 随着时间的推移，她感到越来越不安。
words.en: A feeling of anxiety or discomfort.

words.tr: n. 藤；藤蔓；藤本植物；葡萄藤；
words.ex: The grapes grow on a vine.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄长在藤上。
words.en: A vine is a plant that climbs up or along a support, such as a wall or trellis, and produces fruit or flowers.

words.tr: n. 格子；格子结构；框架; vt. 为……搭棚架；使交叉成格子状；使交织
words.ex: The vines grew up the trellis.
words.ex_cn: 藤蔓沿着棚架生长。
words.en: A trellis is a framework of light wooden or metal bars, chiefly used as a support for fruit trees or climbing plants.

words.ex: The elm tree stands near the old house.
words.ex_cn: 榆树长在老房子旁边。
words.en: An elm is a type of tree that is common in northern countries, which has broad leaves and can grow to a great size.

words.ex: The child blew a dandelion in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里吹了一朵蒲公英。
words.en: A dandelion is a wild plant which has yellow flowers with lots of thin petals. When the petals fall, they are replaced by a fluffy white ball of seeds.

words.tr: adv. 随意地；偶然地；漫不经心地
words.ex: He casually waved at his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地向朋友挥了挥手。
words.en: In a way that suggests a lack of concern or seriousness.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.tr:
n. 丛；笨重的脚步声；土块
v. 使成一丛；凝结成块；拖着沉重的步子走
words.ex: The grass formed a clump near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 草在篱笆附近长成了一簇。
words.en: A clump of things such as trees or plants is a small group of them growing together. A clump of earth or mud is a small, solid mass of it.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.tr: adj. 感到宽慰的； v. 缓解；“relieve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt relieved when he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 当他通过考试时，他感到宽慰。
words.en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

words.ex: She smiled reassuringly at the anxious child.
words.ex_cn: 她对那个焦虑的孩子安慰地笑了笑。
words.en: In a manner that removes someone's doubts or fears.

words.ex: Her mother gave her encouragement before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 考试前，她妈妈给了她鼓励。
words.en: Encouragement is the act of giving someone support, confidence, or hope.

words.tr:
n. 后台；
adv. 在后台；
words.ex: The actors waited backstage before the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在演出前在后台等候。
words.en: Behind the scenes in a theater or relating to the private lives of people in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: She curls her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上卷头发。
words.en: To form into a spiral or curved shape; a piece of hair that grows in a curved shape.

words.tr:
n. 不成功；
v. 猛落；沉重地落下；
words.ex: The movie was a flop at the box office.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影在票房上失败了。
words.en: If something flops, it is completely unsuccessful.

words.tr: adv. 懒洋洋地；慢吞吞地
words.ex: He walked lazily to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他懒洋洋地向门口走去。
words.en: In a manner that shows an unwillingness to work or use energy; idly.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr: phrase. 纸巾；厨房用纸；一次性吸水纸
words.ex: She used a paper towel to dry the dishes.
words.ex_cn: 她用厨房纸巾擦干碗碟。
words.en: A paper towel is an absorbent textile made from paper instead of cloth, used for drying hands, wiping windows, and other cleaning purposes.

words.tr:
v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸
n. 游泳
words.ex: He bathes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗澡。
words.en: To bathe means to wash oneself or someone else, especially in a bath or the sea, or to spend time in water for pleasure.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: I am terribly sorry for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我为这个错误非常抱歉。
words.en: Used to emphasize the extreme degree of something.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr: adj. 激励人的；有刺激性的；振奋人的； v. “stimulate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a stimulating talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们做了一场激励人的演讲。
words.en: Making you feel enthusiastic and full of ideas.

words.tr: adj. 胀大的； v. “inflate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The balloon became inflated after he blew air into it.
words.ex_cn: 他往气球里吹气后，气球就胀大了。
words.en: If you describe prices, estimates, or claims as inflated, you mean that they are too high or too great.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.tr: adj, 易碎成小薄片的；易剥落的；古怪的；不可靠的
words.ex: The pastry was flaky and delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这糕点薄而易剥落，非常美味。
words.en: If something is flaky, it means it is made of or easily breaks into small, thin pieces. It can also describe someone who is unreliable or eccentric.

words.tr: adj. 弄皱的； v. “crumple”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He picked up the crumpled paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了那张皱巴巴的纸。
words.en: If something is crumpled, it is crushed or bent out of its original shape, often in a way that makes it look untidy.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 萦绕在你心头的；你在想的；令你挂念的
words.ex: What's on your mind?
words.ex_cn: 你心里在想什么？
words.en: If something is on your mind, you are thinking or worrying about it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 挖出；发掘；找出（信息、证据等）
words.ex: He digs up old toys from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里挖出旧玩具。
words.en: To remove something from the ground by digging; to discover something by searching.

words.tr: phrase. 说服；争取到支持；使改变立场
words.ex: The candidate managed to win over a significant portion of the undecided voters.
words.ex_cn: 这位候选人成功地争取到了相当一部分尚未决定的选民的支持。
words.en: to persuade someone to support you or to agree to something

words.tr: phrase. 完全一样地；丝毫不差地（用于强调程度相当）
words.ex: She is every bit as talented as her sister.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的姐姐一样有才华。
words.en: used to emphasize that someone or something is just as good, important, etc. as someone or something else

words.tr: phrase. 过来；顺便来访；改变立场；突然感觉；显得
words.ex: Come over to my house after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后到我家来。
words.en: To move or travel towards someone or something, especially in order to visit them.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾；回想；追忆（过去的事情）
words.ex: I look back on my childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 我满怀幸福地回忆我的童年。
words.en: To think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: 短语动词. 被光线笼罩；沐浴在光明中
words.ex: The room was bathed in the warm glow of the morning sun.
words.ex_cn: 房间沐浴在早晨阳光的温暖光辉中。
words.en: To be completely illuminated or surrounded by light.

words.tr: 短语. 被阳光沐浴；沐浴在阳光中
words.ex: The garden was bathed in sunshine, making it a perfect spot for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 花园沐浴在阳光中，成为了一个完美的野餐地点。
words.en: To be covered or filled with sunlight.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.tr: adj. 弯腰的，曲背的 v. 弯腰( stoop的过去式和过去分词 ); 屈身; 俯首; 屈尊
words.ex: The old man walked with a stooped posture.
words.ex_cn: 那位老人弯着腰走路。
words.en: If someone is stooped, their back and shoulders are bent forward.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: She stared longingly at the dessert menu.
words.ex_cn: 她渴望地盯着甜点菜单。
words.en: In a way that shows a strong desire or wish for something.

words.ex: She is fond of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巧克力。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them very much.

words.ex: He rediscovered his love for music after years.
words.ex_cn: 多年后，他重新发现了对音乐的热爱。
words.en: To discover again something that was lost or forgotten.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The book was dusty on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上积满了灰尘。
words.en: Covered with or resembling dust; dry and powdery.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: She licked her lip before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 她在说话前舔了舔嘴唇。
words.en: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；热望
adj. 渴望的；热望的
v. 渴望；热望；“long”的现在分词
v. 用练马绳训练马的各种步态
words.ex: Her longing for home grew stronger each day.
words.ex_cn: 她对家的渴望与日俱增。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting something or someone.
