words.ex: The gardener waters the plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 园丁每天早上给植物浇水。
words.en: A gardener is someone who takes care of a garden as a job or hobby.

words.ex: The flower has a sweet fragrance.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有一种甜美的香味。
words.en: A fragrance is a pleasant smell, especially that of a flower or perfume.

words.tr: v. 珍爱；爱惜；怀念；怀有（感情）；抱有（希望）
words.ex: I cherish the time I spend with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人共度的时光。
words.en: If you cherish something, you care for it lovingly and protect it carefully.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: He erased the wrong answer with an eraser.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了错误的答案。
words.en: To erase something means to remove it completely from a surface or from a place where it is stored.

words.tr: adj. 皮包骨头的；极瘦的；
words.ex: The skinny dog had no meat on its bones.
words.ex_cn: 那只皮包骨头的狗身上一点肉都没有。
words.en: Very thin, especially in a way that is unattractive.

words.ex: His handwriting is very neat.
words.ex_cn: 他的笔迹非常工整。
words.en: Handwriting is the style of writing that someone uses when they write with a pen or pencil.

words.tr:
v. 叹息；叹气
n. 叹息；叹气
words.ex: He sighed when he saw the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 他看到凌乱的房间时叹了口气。
words.en: To sigh is to let out a deep breath slowly and audibly, often as a sign of sadness, tiredness, or relief.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；行进；设法到达；努力获得成功
words.ex: Please make your way to the exit slowly.
words.ex_cn: 请慢慢走向出口。
words.en: To move or travel, especially with difficulty or effort, towards a destination.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: phrase. 沉浸于；全神贯注于；迷失在
words.ex: He is lost in his thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 他沉浸在自己的思绪中。
words.en: To be so absorbed in something that one is unaware of one's surroundings.

words.ex: The wind wears away the rock slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢地磨损了石头。
words.en: To erode or diminish gradually through friction, use, or exposure.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊讶的；惊人的； v. “astonish”的现在分词；
words.ex: The magician did an astonishing trick.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了一个令人惊讶的魔术。
words.en: If something is astonishing, it is very surprising.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The government studies macroeconomic trends to fix the economy.
words.ex_cn: 政府研究宏观经济趋势以改善经济。
words.en: Macroeconomic refers to the branch of economics concerned with large-scale or general economic factors, such as interest rates and national productivity.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支柱；道具
v. 支撑；靠
words.ex: He uses a prop to support the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个道具来支撑架子。
words.en: A prop is an object or piece of furniture that is used in a play or film to make a scene look more realistic, or something that is used to support or hold up another object.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr:
v. 夺取；一把抓住
n. 夺取；一把抓住；音乐片段
words.ex: He tried to snatch the bag from her hand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从她手中抢走包。
words.en: If you snatch something, or if you snatch at it, you take it or pull it away quickly.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: The bank showed a debit on my account.
words.ex_cn: 银行在我的账户上显示了一笔借记。
words.en: A debit is an accounting entry that results in either an increase in assets or a decrease in liabilities on a company's balance sheet.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.ex: He showed reverence for his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他对祖父表示尊敬。
words.en: A feeling of profound respect for someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr: v. 使大吃一惊；击晕( stun的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The news stunned her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她大吃一惊。
words.en: If you are stunned by something, you are extremely shocked or surprised by it and therefore unable to speak or react for a while.

words.tr:
v. 使发昏；使迷乱
n. 恍惚； 晕眩
words.ex: The loud noise dazed him for a moment.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他一时发昏。
words.en: If someone is in a daze, they are feeling confused and unable to think clearly, often because they have had a shock or surprise.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: The loud music was a diversion from his worries.
words.ex_cn: 那嘈杂的音乐分散了他对烦恼的注意力。
words.en: A diversion is an action or event that attracts your attention away from what you are doing or should be doing.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.ex: His pursuit of happiness made him work hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他对幸福的追求让他每天努力工作。
words.en: The act of pursuing something or someone, especially in order to catch or achieve them.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.tr: v. 指错方向；误导；使用不当
words.ex: The instructions were misdirected and led us to the wrong location.
words.ex_cn: 这些指示误导了我们，导致我们去了错误的地方。
words.en: To direct someone or something incorrectly or towards the wrong place or purpose.

words.ex: The rain deepened the puddles on the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水加深了路上的水坑。
words.en: If a situation or emotion deepens or if something deepens it, it becomes stronger and more intense.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr: phrase. 文科；人文科学（包括语言、哲学、历史、文学、艺术等学科）
words.ex: He majors in liberal arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修文科。
words.en: The liberal arts are academic subjects such as history, literature, and languages, as distinct from professional and technical subjects.

words.ex: The music resonates with her emotions.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与她的情感产生共鸣。
words.en: If something resonates, it vibrates and produces a deep, strong sound. If a place or situation resonates, it seems full of a particular quality or feeling.

words.tr: phrase. 支撑某物；用支柱撑住某物；扶持；支持
words.ex: He used a stick to prop up the leaning fence.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子支撑倾斜的篱笆。
words.en: To prop something up means to support it or keep it in a particular position by placing something underneath or against it.

words.tr: phrase. 要不是某人；若非某人的话
words.ex: If it wasn't for you, I wouldn't have made it.
words.ex_cn: 要不是因为你，我不会成功的。
words.en: Used to say that someone or something was the only reason why a particular thing happened or did not happen.

words.tr: phrase. 要不是某事；若非某事；如果没有某事的话
words.ex: If it wasn't for your help, I wouldn't have finished this project on time.
words.ex_cn: 要不是因为你的帮助，我无法按时完成这个项目。
words.en: Used to say that something would not have happened if a particular thing had not existed or happened.

words.tr: phrase. 要不是某人；若非某人
words.ex: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have known how to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 要不是因为你，我还不知道怎么解决这个问题。
words.en: Used to say that someone or something prevented a particular situation from being worse or different.

words.tr: phrase. 要不是某事；若非某事；倘若没有某事
words.ex: If it weren't for your help, I wouldn't have finished the task on time.
words.ex_cn: 要不是因为你的帮助，我就不能按时完成任务了。
words.en: Used to say that something would not have happened or would not be the case without a particular thing or person.

words.tr: phrase. 匆匆翻阅；快速浏览（书页、文件等）
words.ex: He likes to leaf through magazines at the doctor's office.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在医生办公室翻阅杂志。
words.en: To quickly turn the pages of a book, magazine, etc., and look at them without reading them in detail.

words.ex: He will embark on a new journey next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将开始一段新的旅程。
words.en: To start or begin something, especially something new, challenging, or exciting.

words.ex: He will embark upon a new job next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将开始一份新工作。
words.en: To start or engage in a new project or course of action, especially one that is important or challenging.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.ex: He is working on his doctoral thesis in physics.
words.ex_cn: 他正在撰写他的物理学博士论文。
words.en: Relating to or constituting a doctorate.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.tr: n. 非小说类文学作品；非虚构的（纪实类的）文学作品
words.ex: He likes to read nonfiction books about history.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于历史的非虚构书籍。
words.en: Nonfiction is writing that gives information or describes real events, rather than telling a story.

words.tr: adv. 醒目地；显著地；惊人地；
words.ex: The painting is strikingly colorful.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画醒目地色彩鲜艳。
words.en: In a way that is very noticeable or obvious.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 先已存在的；早已存在的
words.ex: The injury was pre-existing before the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故前伤势已经存在。
words.en: Existing before something else.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: He still has unfulfilled dreams.
words.ex_cn: 他仍有未实现的梦想。
words.en: If you describe someone's ambitions, hopes, or desires as unfulfilled, you mean that they have not yet achieved the things that they want.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He made his decision after long deliberation.
words.ex_cn: 他在深思熟虑后做出了决定。
words.en: Deliberation is the long and careful consideration of a subject.

words.ex: The premise of his argument is that everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他论点的前提是人人平等。
words.en: A premise is a statement or idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr: adj. 最低限度的；极少的；最小的；
words.ex: He made minimal changes to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对计划做了最低限度的修改。
words.en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr: n. 总部；司令部；指挥部；
words.ex: The company's headquarters is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a company, organization, or military unit.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.tr: adj. 不可动摇的；坚定不移的；
words.ex: His belief in justice is unshakable.
words.ex_cn: 他对正义的信念是不可动摇的。
words.en: If you describe someone's beliefs as unshakable, you are emphasizing that they are so strong that they cannot be destroyed or changed.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.ex_cn: 木头表面很粗糙。
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.ex: The brilliance of the sun made the sky bright.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的光辉让天空变得明亮。
words.en: The quality of being exceptionally clever or talented.

words.ex: He chose an occupational therapy course.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一门职业治疗课程。
words.en: Relating to a job or profession.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示应该做某事，被期望做某事，或注定要做某事
words.ex: You are meant to wash your hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 你应该在吃饭前洗手。
words.en: If you say that something is meant to have a particular quality or characteristic, you mean that it has a reputation for being like that.

words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.tr: phrase. 放进；插入；提出；提交；使就职；进港
words.ex: Put in the keys before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前把钥匙放进去。
words.en: To place something inside or into a particular position or location.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: The spandrel above the door is decorated with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 门上方的三角形空间装饰着花朵。
words.en: A spandrel is the space between two arches or between an arch and a rectangular enclosure.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: The teacher designated him as the group leader.
words.ex_cn: 老师指派他为组长。
words.en: If you designate someone or something as a particular thing, you formally give them that description or name.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: He is studying civil engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习土木工程。
words.en: Civil engineering is the profession of designing and executing structural works that serve the general public, such as dams, bridges, aqueducts, canals, highways, power plants, sewerage systems, and other infrastructure.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探揭开了真相。
words.en: To uncover something means to remove the cover from it or to reveal it by investigation or inquiry.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 暗箱；针孔成像装置（一种利用小孔成像原理在暗室内形成外部景物倒像的光学仪器）
words.ex: The camera obscura was used to project images onto a screen.
words.ex_cn: 暗箱被用来将图像投影到屏幕上。
words.en: A camera obscura is an optical device that led to photography and the photographic camera. It consists of a box or room with a hole in one side. Light from an external scene passes through the hole and strikes a surface inside, where it is reproduced, inverted (thus upside-down), but with color and perspective preserved.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: The battery has a voltage of 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池的电压是9伏特。
words.en: Voltage is the electrical force measured in volts that is needed to make a current flow in a circuit.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.ex: The company will deploy new software next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周部署新软件。
words.en: To deploy troops or military resources means to organize or position them so that they are ready to be used.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.ex: The reactor operates in a supercritical state.
words.ex_cn: 反应堆在超临界状态下运行。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a state of a substance in which it is at a temperature and pressure above its critical point, at which it can exist as both a liquid and a gas.

words.ex: The combustion of wood produces heat and smoke.
words.ex_cn: 木材的燃烧会产生热量和烟雾。
words.en: Combustion is a chemical process in which a substance reacts with oxygen to give off heat and light.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.tr: phrase. 燃料电池；一种将燃料（如氢气）和氧化剂的化学能直接转化为电能的装置
words.ex: Fuel cells are used to generate electricity in spacecraft.
words.ex_cn: 燃料电池用于在航天器中发电。
words.en: A fuel cell is a device that converts the chemical energy from a fuel into electricity through a chemical reaction with oxygen or another oxidizing agent.

words.ex: Supercomputing is essential for solving complex scientific problems.
words.ex_cn: 超级计算对于解决复杂的科学问题至关重要。
words.en: Supercomputing refers to the practice of using very powerful computers to solve complex computational problems that are beyond the capability of smaller-scale machines.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The computer has a fast processor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的处理器。
words.en: A processor is a part of a computer that interprets and carries out instructions.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr: n. 漫游者；流浪者；漂泊者；
words.ex: The rover explored the surface of Mars.
words.ex_cn: 漫游者探索了火星表面。
words.en: A rover is someone who travels around, often without a fixed route or destination. It can also refer to a vehicle designed to travel over the rough surface of a planet or moon.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: He is learning quantum physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习量子物理。
words.en: In physics, a quantum is the minimum amount of any physical entity involved in an interaction.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.ex: His entrepreneurship helped start a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他的企业家精神帮助创办了一家小企业。
words.en: Entrepreneurship is the activity of setting up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.tr:
n. 基层；基层民众；草根
adj. 基层的；草根的；乡村的
words.ex: The grassroots movement started in small towns.
words.ex_cn: 这个基层运动起源于小镇。
words.en: The grassroots of an organization or movement are the ordinary people who form the main part of it, rather than its leaders.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.tr: n. 跳背游戏; v. 玩跳背游戏；越级提升；超过，超越；跨越（障碍）
words.ex: The company decided to leapfrog its competitors by introducing a new technology.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定通过引入新技术来超越其竞争对手。
words.en: Leapfrog is a game in which players vault over each other's stooped backs. It can also mean to move ahead or make progress by skipping over something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.tr: phrase. 令人感到意外；出乎意料地发生
words.ex: The good news did not come as a surprise.
words.ex_cn: 这个好消息并不令人意外。
words.en: To happen unexpectedly, causing surprise.

words.ex: The factory will shut down next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂下个月将关闭。
words.en: To close something, especially a business or machine, so that it stops operating.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: He mows the lawn with a lawnmower.
words.ex_cn: 他用割草机修剪草坪。
words.en: A lawnmower is a machine that cuts grass on lawns.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.tr: n. 戴在头上的耳机或听筒
words.ex: He wears a headset to listen to music.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着耳机听音乐。
words.en: A headset is a pair of headphones, especially one with a microphone attached.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: The virtual reality game is immersive.
words.ex_cn: 这个虚拟现实游戏非常沉浸式。
words.en: Providing, involving, or characterized by deep absorption or immersion in something (especially a particular activity or environment).

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.ex: The model is three-dimensional.
words.ex_cn: 这个模型是三维的。
words.en: Having or appearing to have length, breadth, and depth.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The frog hopped over the stone.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跃过了那块石头。
words.en: To move by jumping on one foot or to move quickly and lightly from one place to another.

words.ex: The jet flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It can also refer to a stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening, or to travel by jet aircraft.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: He works remotely from home.
words.ex_cn: 他从家远程工作。
words.en: If something is done remotely, it is done from a distance, usually by means of technology.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.tr: phrase. 普通人；无名氏（指代一个普通、无特别之处的人）
words.ex: The new policy will affect Joe Bloggs more than anyone else.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对普通人乔·布洛格斯的影响比任何人都大。
words.en: An ordinary person, especially a man, who is not famous or important.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.tr: adv. 在人力所能及的范围内；
words.ex: We tried humanly to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 我们尽人力所能及地按时完成了项目。
words.en: In a manner that is characteristic of or befitting a human being; within human capabilities.

words.tr: n. 模拟装置；仿真器；模拟程序
words.ex: He uses a flight simulator to practice flying.
words.ex_cn: 他使用飞行模拟器来练习飞行。
words.en: A simulator is a device that artificially creates the effect of being in conditions of some kind, often for the purpose of training or testing.

words.ex: The immersion of the rock in water made it wet.
words.ex_cn: 石头浸入水中后变湿了。
words.en: Immersion is the process of learning a language or skill by surrounding oneself with it in a natural or simulated environment.

words.tr: phrase. 在运转中；在战斗中
words.ex: The machine is in action.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器正在运转。
words.en: If someone or something is in action, they are doing the activity or work that is typical for them.

words.tr: phrase. 处于控制之中；掌握局势；能控制局面
words.ex: He is in control of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他掌控着这辆车。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.ex: We go to the cinema now and again.
words.ex_cn: 我们偶尔会去看电影。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: Every now and again, I like to go for a long walk in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 偶尔，我喜欢去乡村里长时间散步。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.w: get in the way of sth.
words.tr: phrase. v. 妨碍某事；阻挡某事的进行
words.uk: ɡet ɪn ðə weɪ ɒv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɡet ɪn ðə weɪ əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: Don't let fear get in the way of your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 不要让恐惧阻碍你的梦想。
words.en: To prevent or hinder something from happening or progressing.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase.  更不必说；不必提及
words.ex: He can run fast, not to mention jump high.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，更不用说跳得高了。
words.en: Used to introduce an additional point which reinforces the point being made.

words.tr: phrase. v. 阻止；防止；避开（问题或危险）；动身前往
words.ex: We tried to head off the storm by closing the windows.
words.ex_cn: 我们试图通过关窗来阻止风暴。
words.en: To take action in order to prevent something from happening or to start a journey.

words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He shows diligence in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天认真完成作业。
words.en: Conscientiousness in paying proper attention to a task; giving the degree of care required in a given situation.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.ex: She worked tirelessly to achieve her goals.
words.ex_cn: 她不倦地工作以实现她的目标。
words.en: If someone works tirelessly, they work very hard without stopping or resting.

words.ex: The devil made him do it.
words.ex_cn: 魔鬼让他这么做的。
words.en: In Christian theology, the devil is the supreme spirit of evil, often represented as the tempter of humankind and the enemy of God and goodness.

words.tr:
v. 无所事事；闲荡
adj. 懈怠的；闲散的；不做事的
words.ex: He idles away the whole afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他整个下午都无所事事。
words.en: If you describe someone as idle, you mean they are not doing anything or they are not working hard.

words.tr: adj. 撒旦的；恶魔的；邪恶的
words.ex: The movie had satanic symbols in the scenes.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的场景中有一些撒旦的符号。
words.en: If you describe something as satanic, you mean that it is extremely evil or wicked.

words.tr: n. 民间传说；民俗学；民间风俗；
words.ex: The old man told us a folklore about a dragon living in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 老人给我们讲了一个关于住在山里的龙的民间传说。
words.en: Folklore is the traditional stories, customs, and habits of a particular community or nation.

words.tr:
adj. 道德的；道义上的；
n. 寓意；
words.ex: It is a moral duty to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 说实话是一种道德责任。
words.en: Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior and the goodness or badness of human character.

words.ex: He told a tale about a brave knight.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于勇敢骑士的故事。
words.en: A tale is a story, especially one that is full of exciting or magical events.

words.ex: He is an industrious student who studies every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个勤勉的学生，每天都学习。
words.en: Someone who is industrious works hard and is determined.

words.ex: The peasant worked in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民每天早上都在田里劳作。
words.en: A peasant is a poor person of low social status who works on the land; used of people who live in countries where farming is still a common way of life.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的； v. “compel”的现在分词；
words.ex: His story was compelling and made everyone listen.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事令人信服，让所有人都认真聆听。
words.en: A compelling argument or reason is one that makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.tr: adv. 学术上；学术地；理论上；
words.ex: He performs academically better than his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他在学术上比同学们表现得更好。
words.en: In a way that relates to education and scholarship.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: Children learn socialization through playing with others.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过与其他孩子玩耍来学习社交。
words.en: The process by which individuals learn and adopt the behaviors and norms of their society or group.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.tr: n. 西方人；西欧人；（美国的）西部人
words.ex: The westerner tried dumplings for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这位西方人第一次尝试了饺子。
words.en: A person from the western part of a country or the Western world.

words.ex: His estimation of the situation was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对形势的判断是错误的。
words.en: An estimation is a judgment or opinion about the value, quality, or importance of something, or a calculation of the amount, level, or size of something.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: adj. 小规模的，卑贱不足取的，三流的
words.ex: He was just a small-time crook.
words.ex_cn: 他只是个三流的小混混。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as small-time, you think they are not very important because their influence or effect is not great, especially in comparison to other things or people of the same type.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.tr: n. 冒险者，喜欢冒险的人
words.ex: She is a natural risk-taker, always eager to try new things.
words.ex_cn: 她天生喜欢冒险，总是渴望尝试新事物。
words.en: A risk-taker is someone who is willing to take risks in order to achieve something.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.ex: The city became prosperous after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市变得繁荣了。
words.en: A prosperous person, place, or economy is rich and successful.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.ex: The company plans to diversify its products.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划使产品多样化。
words.en: To diversify means to make or become more varied or different. It often refers to the process of a company or individual expanding their range of products or activities to reduce risk or to explore new opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.ex: He goes beyond what the teacher asks.
words.ex_cn: 他做得比老师要求的更多。
words.en: To exceed or surpass a certain limit or expectation.

words.ex: He likes tea, as opposed to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: used to make a contrast between two things

words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.ex: He voted in opposition to the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他投票反对新政策。
words.en: If you are in opposition to someone or something, you disagree with them or are against them.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.ex: Historically, people used abacus for counting.
words.ex_cn: 历史上，人们用算盘进行计算。
words.en: In a way that relates to the study of past events.

words.ex: The old ship was a monster on the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船在海上是个庞然大物。
words.en: A monster is an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly, and frightening.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.ex: The benevolent man gave food to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 这位慈善的人给穷人提供了食物。
words.en: If you describe a person in authority as benevolent, you mean that they are kind and fair.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.tr: n. 神龛；神社；圣地；圣殿
words.ex: People visit the shrine to pray.
words.ex_cn: 人们去神社祈祷。
words.en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr: n. 英雄表现；英雄气概
words.ex: His heroism saved many lives during the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他的英勇行为在火灾中救了许多人的生命。
words.en: Heroism is great bravery, especially in a difficult situation or in a war.

words.ex: The imperial palace was built long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这座帝国宫殿是很久以前建造的。
words.en: relating to an empire or an emperor; majestic or superior in quality or size

words.tr:
n. 长袍
v. （使）穿上长袍
words.ex: He puts on a white robe after the shower.
words.ex_cn: 他洗完澡后穿上一件白袍。
words.en: A robe is a long, loose piece of clothing that covers all of your body and reaches the ground. It is often worn for ceremonies or in the home.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.tr:
v. 蹲伏；蜷缩
n. 蹲伏；蜷缩
words.ex: The cat crouched low to catch the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹲伏下来抓老鼠。
words.en: If you crouch, you bend your legs so that you are close to the ground and leaning forward slightly.

words.ex: She typically arrives early for class.
words.ex_cn: 她往往很早就到课。
words.en: You use typically to say that something usually happens in the way that you are describing.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.ex: The paddler rowed the boat slowly across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 划船者慢慢地划船穿过湖面。
words.en: A paddler is someone who paddles a canoe or kayak, or who wades in water.

words.ex: He is a drummer in a rock band.
words.ex_cn: 他是摇滚乐队的一名鼓手。
words.en: A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums.

words.ex: The steersman skillfully navigated the boat through the narrow channel.
words.ex_cn: 舵手熟练地驾驶着船通过狭窄的水道。
words.en: A steersman is a person who steers a ship or boat.

words.tr: adj. 装饰性的；作装饰用的；
words.ex: The room has decorative flowers on the table.
words.ex_cn: 房间里桌上有一些装饰性的花。
words.en: Something that is decorative is intended to look pretty or attractive.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: The cat used its claw to scratch the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫用爪子抓树。
words.en: A claw is a curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals. As a verb, it means to scratch, tear, or pull with claws or fingernails.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr: v. 同意；赞成；“agree”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已一致的；同意的；
words.ex: We agreed to meet at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们同意下午五点见面。
words.en: If people are agreed, they have reached a joint decision on something or have the same opinion about something.

words.tr:
n. 强烈的性欲；强烈的欲望
v. 对…有极强的性欲（或欲望）
words.ex: His lust for power ruined his relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了他的关系。
words.en: Lust is a strong feeling of wanting to have or to do something, especially sexual desire.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.ex: The conquest of the mountain took three days.
words.ex_cn: 攻克这座山花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of conquering a place or people.

words.ex: The elimination of waste is important for health.
words.ex_cn: 排除废物对健康很重要。
words.en: The act of removing or getting rid of something completely.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: He enjoys eating Welsh rarebit on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末吃威尔士兔肉。
words.en: To fail to honor a debt or obligation, especially a gambling debt.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: He saw his neighbor as a foe.
words.ex_cn: 他把邻居看作敌人。
words.en: A foe is someone who opposes or fights against another; an enemy.

words.ex: He felt victorious after winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后感到胜利。
words.en: Having won a victory; conquering.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.ex: The school forbids students to use phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: To forbid something means to order that it must not be done.

words.tr: phrase. 听说某人；知道某人的存在
words.ex: Have you heard of the new teacher?
words.ex_cn: v. 你听说过新老师吗？
words.en: To become aware of someone or something through hearing about them from others.

words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.
